Fix `packages/excalidraw/tests/pages.test.tsx` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. yarn test:app --watch=false fails one of the new Gate 3 tests:
 FAIL  packages/excalidraw/tests/pages.test.tsx > Multi-page support > renders only the active page's elements in renderStaticScene (AC-2)
AssertionError: expected [] to include 'render-rect-page-b'
 ❯ packages/excalidraw/tests/pages.test.tsx:775:24
    773|     const elementsMapKeys = Array.from(lastRenderConfig.elementsMap.ke…
    774| 
    775|     expect(visibleIds).toContain(rectPageB.id);
       |                        ^
    776|     expect(visibleIds).not.toContain(rectPageA.id);
    777|     expect(elementsMapKeys).toContain(rectPageB.id);
⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯[1/1]⎯

The test (renders only the active page's elements in renderStaticScene, AC-2) reads renderStaticScene.mock.lastCall right after `await waitFor(() => expect(renderStaticScene).toHaveBeenCalled())`, so it can read a render that happened before page B's element reached the scene, or a render throttled from the earlier page switch. Scene.replaceAllElements with replaceAllPages (packages/element/src/Scene.ts ~line 370-455) keeps both elements and filters this.elements to the active page, so page B's element should be visible once the scene re-renders. Fix the test, not the source: wait until a render whose visibleElements contains page B's element id (e.g. waitFor(() => expect(renderStaticScene.mock.lastCall?.[0].visibleElements.map(e => e.id)).toContain(rectPageB.id))) and then assert that same config excludes page A's id from visibleElements and from elementsMap keys. Also check the elements sit inside the viewport (page B starts at scrollX/scrollY 0, zoom 1). If, after waiting, page B's element never reaches visibleElements, say so by leaving an assertion that fails with a clear message rather than weakening the isolation assertions. Leave all other tests unchanged.

The file's current text is under Inputs, marked "current text"; your edits apply to exactly that text.

## Answer
Return ONLY a JSON object {"path": "packages/excalidraw/tests/pages.test.tsx", "edits": [{"search": "<text copied exactly from the current text>", "replace": "<its replacement>"}]} with no other text. Each search must appear exactly once in the current text; the edits apply in order.
If the file does not exist yet, or the change rewrites most of it, return {"path": "packages/excalidraw/tests/pages.test.tsx", "content": "<the complete file>"} instead.
